beats: Your AI writes like everyone else's AI.
Same openers.
Same tired phrases.
And your customers can tell.
So build a fix inside Claude.
It's called a voice skill, and it takes about ten minutes.
A skill is a file Claude reads before it writes.
It holds your rules:
how you sound, what you never say, how you end.
Claude only loads it when the job needs it.
Step one.
Give Claude ten pieces of your best writing.
Posts, emails, anything that sounds like you.
Step two.
Ask Claude to study them and write the skill.
It pulls out your sentence length, your favorite words, and the phrases you would never use.
Step three.
Ask for a LinkedIn post.
Claude loads the skill first, then writes.
The first drafts will still slip.
Old habits like "here's the thing" creep back in.
So add a second skill:
a reviewer.
It checks every draft against your banned list before you ever see it.
The starter skill is linked below.
Teach it once, and every draft starts sounding like you.
